top_violation_types.title: School-age Furnishings and Equipment - Age-appropriate Rest Equipment (26 TAC §746.2705(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During rest time, school age children were observed sleeping with there head down on a table instead of having a cot or mat to rest on.

top_violation_types.title: Safety - Play Materials and Equipment Safe (26 TAC §746.3701(5))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: All  playground I observed,  the roof on one of the structures is chipped and/or broken that could injure a child. ( picture taken

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child's file was missing a health statement.

top_violation_types.title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One of four  of the transportation vehicles did not have a first aid kit available for review.  The other 3 vehicles were missing or had expired supplies from the first aid kits that were added during the inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The Director was lacking current transportation training. The operation provides transportation.

top_violation_types.title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist (26 TAC §746.4751(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation has not been documenting their monthly maintenance inspections.

top_violation_types.title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The grassy area on one of the operations playgrounds was found to have a deep step down with the sprinkler system being exposed.

top_violation_types.title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver did not have current training in pediatric first aid.
